title: Grateful Dead Live at KMPX Radio Show on 1967-04-01
lineage: Pre-FM-MR > R > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (remove gaps) > CD Wave (retrack) > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Historic 1967 KSAN radio show with Jerry & Phil’s eclectic music picks and candid banter, captured in clear archival audio.
ai_review.review: The recording offers a rare snapshot of the Grateful Dead’s early influences as Jerry Garcia and Phil Lesh curate an adventurous mix of blues, jazz, folk, avant‑garde classical and contemporary pop for Tom Donahue’s free‑form FM slot. Reviewers praise the insightful chatter, the surprising playlist (e.g., Charles Ives Symphony #4, Junior Wells, Charles Lloyd) and note that the audio download is solid enough to enjoy without major flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen detailed reviews consistently award 4‑5 stars, highlighting both the cultural significance of the content and acceptable audio quality; only one neutral comment and one technical complaint about a broken link do not detract from the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers mention clear, listenable download quality; no major complaints about hiss or drop‑outs, though one user reported a broken link. The recording appears to be an off‑air FM capture rather than a soundboard feed.

standout_songs: Sittin' On Top Of The World
show_quality.setlist_flow: A loose, interview‑style set that weaves together short music excerpts with Jerry and Phil’s commentary; the eclectic sequence feels purposeful in illustrating their influences rather than a conventional concert flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as engaged and enthusiastic; his commentary on Otis Redding and other artists is highlighted.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned as slightly slurred at times but offering sharp, knowledgeable takes on the music.
